book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: Bita bɛ Joŋ fɛ kiŋkɛlɛ
Gɛ̀ bee juu chimi, Bita bɛ Joŋ ja bo bɛɛne fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le juu bikaa bitɛde fɛnshɛ, gɛ̀ bee kife ki buunɛ.

Gɛh kife kiyu le, bamii tuu muh mu bo too bɛ wu, bo shiishɛ wu fɛ jwe wu kitaŋ wù ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ wù Joŋe wù gɛ̀ leese fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le. Muh wuyu ba gɛ̀ boyi wu, wù nyu kiŋkɛlɛ, bamii gɛ̀ tuude wu aju achii bo too bo shiishi fɛ wu lɛgɛ bige fo a bamii ba fede bo leese yeh yi kintanyɛ le.
Wu yɛŋ Bita bɛ Joŋ bo fede ki bo lee yu, wu mo wu tu wu lɛgɛ bige a bo le.
Bita bɛ Joŋ noŋ ajii yi ye ye le. Bita jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Bîjɛ bee!”
Wu mo wu bijɛ bo, wu kwaji lɛ bo le bo nyâ wu fiɛɛ.
Bita jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Gɛ ŋkɛme bige gɛ mbɛŋ, geenɛ, fiɛɛ fì ŋkɛme nlé nnyâ wo le. Njɛme wo le a jee chi Jiso Kletu wu Nasalɛ le lɛ, jâ we wo jîɛnyi!”
No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu jijɛ wu yi kibo kinchiɛɛŋ le, wu chiaasɛ wu we. Kimimia, bikaa bɛ muŋgolo bi muh wuyu mo bi tɛmɛ.
Wu selɛ we wu lɛɛŋ, wu mo wu kɛ wu tu wu jiɛnyi. Bɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo lee fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, wu tu wu jiɛnyi fo wu seele we, wu yuuse Nyo.
Bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ yɛde no wu jiɛnyi wu yuuse Nyo,
bo kɛɛ lɛ le muh wù gɛ̀ shee wu lɛgɛ kilɛgɛ jwe wu kitaŋ wù Joŋe wù leese fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le. Ajii jiiŋ bo, bo kɛme kiŋgha yi fiɛɛ fì kooshi bɛ wu le.
Bita jɛmɛ bamii le fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le
Muh wuyu ŋɛɛŋ lo yi Bita bɛ Joŋ le. Bamii yɛŋ de yuŋ bo, bo tu bo lege bachii bo gɛɛne bo taade bo le fɛ kijusɛ kì ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Ŋgaa yi Salamoŋ le.

Bita yɛŋ no bamii taashɛ bo too, wu mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Bamii ba Ishwala, le nje la wu jwe yune bɛŋ kune fiɛɛ finɛ, fɛ bɛŋ jiiŋe bee nɛ? Bɛŋ kwaji fiena lɛ ge bvuŋga bwesa muh wunɛ fɛ wu jiɛnyi? Noo bɛŋ kwaji tɛ lɛ ge kinche kesa kì yuude le? Gɛ nyu noo gɛ.

Fi le lɛ Nyo wu Ablaham bɛ wu Asik mo wu Yakob, wu le Nyo wu bachiji chiji besa bachii gɛ̀ bɛɛŋsɛ wa Jiso muh we wu lɛme le wu gɛɛ wu mbebe ye le. Jiso wunɛ le wu wù bɛŋ gɛ̀ faŋ, bɛŋ jo bɛŋ nya bamii ba sage le, Balɛt tu wu goone ki wu chînɛ wu le, bɛŋ faŋ.
Jiso gɛ̀ bee muh wu yuude, wù nyu chaaŋ, bɛŋ faŋ wu, bɛŋ jɛmɛ lɛ ba bvusɛ nyu muh wù gɛ̀ yuuyi bamii, ba nya bɛŋ le.
Bɛŋ gɛ̀ ge noo bɛŋ mo bɛŋ yuuyɛ muh wù nyaa kinche bamii le. Geenɛ, Nyo kaasɛ wu bvusɛ wu yi kwe le, bee yɛŋ wu le bee mo be sɛŋe kune wu.

Ge jee chi Jiso wuyu fɛ kiŋkɛlɛ kinɛ kì bɛŋ yɛde, bɛŋ kee, fɛ ki ja ki jiɛnyi. Fi kooshi noo nje bee le bee lee fitele yi Jiso le, fitele fì bee leese yi ye ye le mo fi ge muh wunɛ mo wu tɛmɛ chuule nɛ no bɛŋ yɛde.
Mɛɛse booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, ŋkêe lɛ fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ bɛ bikwɛɛ biɛna bi woŋ gɛ̀ ge bɛ Jiso le bɛŋ gɛ̀ ge bɛŋ kee gɛ.
Fi gɛ̀ kooshɛ yinɛ je le ki fi gê fi to fi kojɛ no Nyo gɛ̀ ge wa bamii be ba ntuŋ le bachii wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ baaŋ lo lɛ Mbvusɛ we, wu wù gɛ̀ ka lé wu gê wu yɛ̂ŋ ŋgɛ.
Noo, bɛŋ kusɛ muntele mwɛna bɛŋ kaasɛ bɛŋ tu jiŋ fɛ wu le, fi le lɛ wu chiijɛ bimbefɛ biɛna,
wu mo wu ge shɛ́ŋ jɛde bɛŋ, wu chiiŋsɛ Jiso wù Mbvusɛ wù wu gɛ̀ balɛ fɛ bɛŋ le.
Jiso wunɛ kɛme ki wu mɛ̂ fɛwe gɛɛŋ bu kife kì Nyo lé wu gê wu sêesɛ mwɛɛ munchii mu kaasɛ mu tu munfɛŋ, no wu gɛ̀ jɛme de yi bamii be ba ntuŋ ba yuude le baaŋ lo nchensɛŋ.
Musɛ gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: ‘Tada Nyo lé wu gê wu bvûsɛ muh we wu ntuŋ wumu a booŋ ba bwe wene ntɛnɛɛ,
wu chîiŋsɛ fɛ bɛŋ le gɛh no wu gɛ̀ bvusɛ mɛ,
bɛŋ kɛme ki bɛŋ yûge fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme bɛŋ le.
Muh wu le njɛ wu yuge muh wu ntuŋ wuyu le sɛŋ,
le ba nyu ba bvûsɛ wu ŋgoo yi bamii ba Nyo le, ba lɛ̂ɛshɛ lo wu.’

content: Le gɛh tɛ no bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo bachii kɛge yi Samwe le bɛ baa ba gɛ̀ to a wu jiŋ gɛ̀ jɛmɛ wa kune mwɛɛ mù kooshi aju kanɛ le.
Mwɛɛ munchii mù Nyo gɛ̀ ka de yi bamii be ba ntuŋ banɛ le le mwɛna, leh wù Nyo gɛ̀ ji bɛ bachiji chiji bena, le tɛ fɛ bɛŋ le. Le no Nyo gɛ̀ jɛmɛ Ablaham le lɛ,

content.text: ‘Nlé ŋgê nôŋ kimbonɛ yi bamii bachii le yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le,
fede yi mwa wu a wo yeh le.’

content: Nyo mo wu cha muh we wu lɛme wu ya wu tuŋ nyu fɛ bɛŋ le lɛ wu tô wu nôŋ kimbonɛ yi ye yene le, wu gê bɛŋ chinɛ jé yene yì befe le.”
